theorem QOU.MathlibExt.BraidedBlockShiftTrace.tr_blockProd_pn {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (T : OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) [hbt : HeckeSandwichReduces.BraidedTower T] (isP : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred isP] (wp wn : List (ℕ × R × R)) (hp : ∀ l ∈ wp, l.1 ≤ 1) (hn : ∀ l ∈ wn, l.1 ≤ 1) (n : ℕ) :
T.tr (blockProd (fun (k : ℕ) => wordVal T (3 * k) (if isP k then wp else wn)) n) = T.tr (wordVal T 0 wp) ^ (Finset.filter isP (Finset.range (n + 1))).card * T.tr (wordVal T 0 wn) ^ {k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1) | ¬isP k}.card

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.BraidedBlockShiftTrace.tr_blockProd_words {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (T : OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) [hbt : HeckeSandwichReduces.BraidedTower T] (word : ℕ → List (ℕ × R × R)) (hw : ∀ (k : ℕ), ∀ l ∈ word k, l.1 ≤ 1) (n : ℕ) :
T.tr (blockProd (fun (k : ℕ) => wordVal T (3 * k) (word k)) n) = ∏ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), T.tr (wordVal T 0 (word k))

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.BraidedBlockShiftTrace.tr_blockProd {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (T : OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) [hbt : HeckeSandwichReduces.BraidedTower T] (blk : ℕ → A) (hlow : ∀ (k : ℕ), blk k ∈ T.H (3 * k + 2)) (hhigh : ∀ (k : ℕ), blk k ∈ DisjointBlockTrace.shifted T (3 * k)) (n : ℕ) :
T.tr (blockProd blk n) = ∏ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), T.tr (blk k)

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.BraidedBlockShiftTrace.tr_blockProd_of_disjointBlock {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (T : OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) (hD : DisjointBlockTrace.DisjointBlockMultiplicative T) (blk : ℕ → A) (hlow : ∀ (k : ℕ), blk k ∈ T.H (3 * k + 2)) (hhigh : ∀ (k : ℕ), blk k ∈ DisjointBlockTrace.shifted T (3 * k)) (n : ℕ) :
T.tr (blockProd blk n) = ∏ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), T.tr (blk k)

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.BraidedBlockShiftTrace.blockProd_mem_H {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (T : OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) (blk : ℕ → A) (hlow : ∀ (k : ℕ), blk k ∈ T.H (3 * k + 2)) (n : ℕ) :
blockProd blk n ∈ T.H (3 * n + 2)

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.BraidedBlockShiftTrace.blockProd_succ {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] (blk : ℕ → A) (n : ℕ) :
blockProd blk (n + 1) = blockProd blk n * blk (n + 1)

A

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.BraidedBlockShiftTrace.tr_wordVal_shift {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (T : OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) [hbt : HeckeSandwichReduces.BraidedTower T] (L : ℕ) (w : List (ℕ × R × R)) (hw : ∀ l ∈ w, l.1 ≤ L) (off : ℕ) :
T.tr (wordVal T off w) = T.tr (wordVal T 0 w)

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.BraidedBlockShiftTrace.tr_wordVal_succ {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (T : OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) [hbt : HeckeSandwichReduces.BraidedTower T] (off L : ℕ) (w : List (ℕ × R × R)) (hw : ∀ l ∈ w, l.1 ≤ L) :
T.tr (wordVal T (off + 1) w) = T.tr (wordVal T off w)

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.BraidedBlockShiftTrace.cyc_mul_word {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (T : OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) [hbt : HeckeSandwichReduces.BraidedTower T] {s m off : ℕ} (w : List (ℕ × R × R)) :
(∀ l ∈ w, s ≤ off + l.1 ∧ off + l.1 + 1 < s + m) → cyc T s m * wordVal T off w = wordVal T (off + 1) w * cyc T s m

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.BraidedBlockShiftTrace.cyc_mul_letter {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (T : OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) [hbt : HeckeSandwichReduces.BraidedTower T] {s m off : ℕ} (l : ℕ × R × R) (h1 : s ≤ off + l.1) (h2 : off + l.1 + 1 < s + m) :
cyc T s m * letterVal T off l = letterVal T (off + 1) l * cyc T s m

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.BraidedBlockShiftTrace.cyc_mul_g {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (T : OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) [hbt : HeckeSandwichReduces.BraidedTower T] {s t : ℕ} (hst : s ≤ t) (m : ℕ) :
t + 1 < s + m → cyc T s m * T.g t = T.g (t + 1) * cyc T s m

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.BraidedBlockShiftTrace.g_commute_cyc {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (T : OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) [hbt : HeckeSandwichReduces.BraidedTower T] {s t : ℕ} (m : ℕ) :
s + m < t → T.g t * cyc T s m = cyc T s m * T.g t

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.BraidedBlockShiftTrace.cycInv_mul_cyc {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (T : OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) (s m : ℕ) :
cycInv T s m * cyc T s m = 1

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.BraidedBlockShiftTrace.cyc_mul_cycInv {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (T : OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) (s m : ℕ) :
cyc T s m * cycInv T s m = 1

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.BraidedBlockShiftTrace.ginv_letter {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (T : OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) (off i : ℕ) (h : R) (hq : T.g (off + i) * T.g (off + i) = h • T.g (off + i) + 1) :

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.BraidedBlockShiftTrace.wordVal_cons {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (T : OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) (off : ℕ) (l : ℕ × R × R) (w : List (ℕ × R × R)) :
wordVal T off (l :: w) = letterVal T off l * wordVal T off w
